describes: A run on RWX, read back through the GitHub check run it reports for HEAD — so the engine needs gh, not the rwx CLI. A person starts the run (pushing the branch triggers the workflows .rwx/ declares); the engine waits for its check run to complete and passes only on success.
verify: With a run for HEAD finished, run the wait command once by hand from the repo root: it must print the conclusion (success, failure, ...) and exit 0, and print nothing while the run is in progress. The app-slug filter (rwx or mint) is a guess; read the real one from `gh api repos/{owner}/{repo}/commits/HEAD/check-runs --jq '.check_runs[].app.slug'` and narrow it. Then set "verified": true here, with the date in "verifiedAgainst".
needs: gh authenticated (gh auth status) with read access to the repo's checks
RWX reporting check runs to GitHub for the repo

recipe.name: the RWX run for HEAD concludes success

steps.note: triggers the RWX workflows .rwx/ runs on push; a run started by hand with the rwx CLI works too

steps.wait: gh api "repos/{owner}/{repo}/commits/$(git rev-parse HEAD)/check-runs" --jq '[.check_runs[] | select((.app.slug // "") | test("rwx|mint"; "i")) | select(.status=="completed")][0].conclusion // empty' 2>/dev/null
steps.note: prints the run's conclusion once it has completed
the remote run is the proof; this only reads its verdict
